issues.title: Validate Java 25 toolchain and runtime for the backend baseline
issues.body:
## Context

Validation work for #199 and the `upgrade-java-25` change. This issue tracks the compatibility evidence needed for the parent upgrade.

## Requirements and acceptance criteria

- **Validated Java 25 build baseline:** capture Java, Maven and effective compiler, Kotlin, Surefire, annotation processor and test instrumentation versions; verify IAM install and service clean verify under JDK 25, including kapt/MapStruct and existing persistence, security, serialization and Modulith tests. Confirm representative Java and Kotlin class files target major version 69.
- **Consistent development and delivery environments:** build and start the dev container, verify JDK 25, and capture relevant backend CI and security/SBOM outcomes while preserving the scanner's independent Java runtime. Distinguish pre-existing failures using #187 history.
- **Runtime and consumer compatibility:** build the service image, run against isolated PostgreSQL with shipped migrations, verify health and a representative authenticated API request, and inventory IAM consumers and their Java 25 minimum.
- If a required check is blocked or fails, record exact failure, affected version, smallest remedy and deferral criteria; retain Java 21 compilation until resolved.

## Validation commands

```sh
java -version
./service/tournamentmgmt/mvnw -version
./service/tournamentmgmt/mvnw -B -f 3rd_party/iam/pom.xml install
./service/tournamentmgmt/mvnw -B -f service/tournamentmgmt/pom.xml clean verify
npm run format:check
docker build -t rallyon-tournamentmgmt:java25 service/tournamentmgmt
```

Also inspect effective Maven models and representative class-file versions; record dev-container, isolated database/API smoke-test and CI evidence.
